metadataRaw.title: How to Fix One Sided Lower Back Pain FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates how to quickly fix one-sided lower back pain by targeting muscles commonly associated with low back discomfort, including the quadratus lumborum (QL) muscle.

The video is divided into two parts. The first focuses on stretching exercises for immediate relief, while the second covers strengthening exercises for long-term relief—aimed at eliminating lower back pain for good.

Both approaches work differently, so for the best results, try both and see which provides the most relief.

As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done at home with no equipment, and some may offer quick relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now to learn how to get rid of one-sided lower back pain at home!
